understanding: Average Total per BillingCountry, only countries with >=20 invoices.
edge_cases: mixed totals so AVG differs from SUM/MAX
expected: C 5.0; A 2.05 (B with 19 and NULL excluded)
reason: Threshold >=20, NULL exclusion and AVG rounding all behave correctly on the boundary cases.

understanding: Top 5 genres by SUM(UnitPrice*Quantity) over invoice lines, with revenue, descending.
edge_cases: track with NULL genre and large price
differing InvoiceLine price vs quantity so ignoring Quantity gives another order
reason: Uses line-level price*quantity, groups by genre and limits to 5 correctly.

understanding: Tracks appearing in more than 4 distinct playlists, with name and playlist count.
edge_cases: two different tracks with the same name each in 3 playlists
reason: Groups by TrackId, strict >4, does not merge same-named tracks.

understanding: For each country, the customer(s) with highest total invoice spend, ties all listed, with country, name, total.
edge_cases: tie within country X (100 via two invoices vs 100 via one)
two customers with same name in same country
expected: X Ann One 100; X Bob Two 100; Y Cy Three 50
got: X Ann One 100; X Bob Two 100; Y Cy Three 50
reason: RANK handles ties, sums per customer correctly, groups by CustomerId so same names are not merged.

understanding: Number of distinct tracks across all playlists named 'Music' (several playlists may share the name).
edge_cases: two playlists named Music sharing track 1
non-Music playlist containing a Music track
reason: COUNT(pt.TrackId) without DISTINCT double-counts tracks that appear in more than one 'Music' playlist.

understanding: Top 3 genres by average track length in minutes (2 decimals), descending.
edge_cases: genre with many tracks (SUM vs AVG)
track with NULL genre and huge length
reason: Uses AVG with float division by 60000.0, correct rounding, ordering and LIMIT 3.

understanding: Artists with more than 10 albums, with name and album count.
edge_cases: two artists named Dup with 6 albums each (would be 12 if grouped by name)
reason: Groups by ArtistId, strict >10 and handles same-name artists correctly.

understanding: Top 5 customers by total invoice amount in calendar year 2024, descending.
edge_cases: two customers with the same name
expected: C Two 20; C One 15; C Four 12; C Five 11; C Six 9
got: C Two 20; C One 15; C Four 12; C Five 11; C Six 9
reason: strftime year filter handles time-of-day boundaries, groups by CustomerId, ordering and LIMIT correct.

understanding: For each Iron Maiden album, the number of tracks (including albums with zero tracks).
edge_cases: same album title under another artist
reason: LEFT JOIN keeps empty albums, exact name filter, grouped by AlbumId.

understanding: Top 3 artists by line revenue (UnitPrice*Quantity) from German customers in 2024, descending.
reason: Date range includes full last day, country filter and line-level revenue are correct.
